svg.title: A tenant closure has separate local and external claims
svg.desc: An assigned operator starts Shop A closure. A local SQLite transaction closes Shop A, cancels pending jobs, removes its active notes and records counts for an authorized retry. Later reads are denied before warm-cache lookup, while Shop B's same-ID record remains. Completed external effects and copies in backups, files, indexes and logs need separate review. The local receipt does not prove distributed erasure or reversal of completed effects.
svg.text: Closing one shop makes several claims
Synthetic identity and one local SQLite store
A different operator cannot close Shop A.
Set Shop A CLOSED; cancel pending jobs.
Remove its active notes; record counts.
Authorized retry returns the same receipt.
Access stopped in the tested local path
Deny new Shop A reads before warm cache.
Shop B's same-ID note still works.
Review completed effects and in-flight work.
Inventory backups, files, indexes and logs.
Apply each copy's access and retention rule.
It cannot erase every copy or undo an email.
No AWS identity or distributed lifecycle was tested.
